title: Use a single query in verify_password
bug: Logging in with an email address instead of a username stops working.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR removed the email fallback lookup in verify_password, causing authentication to fail for users who log in with their email address instead of username.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR removed the email fallback lookup in verify_password, causing authentication to fail for users who log in with their email address instead of username.

doppel_guided.summary: The PR introduces a regression by removing email-based authentication fallback, breaking login for users who use email as username.
